claims: The 2026 World Baseball Classic is currently underway.
The 2026 World Baseball Classic runs from March 5–17, 2026.
Games of the 2026 World Baseball Classic are held in Miami, Houston, Tokyo, and San Juan.
The championship game of the 2026 World Baseball Classic is scheduled for March 17, 2026, in Miami.
Japan is entering the 2026 World Baseball Classic as the defending champion.
The next World Baseball Classic tournament after 2026 is planned for 2030.
Finals location of the 2026 World Baseball Classic is loanDepot park, Miami, Florida.
20 nations are participating in the 2026 World Baseball Classic.
Participating teams in the 2026 World Baseball Classic include winners from a qualifying tournament in 2025.
Host cities for the 2026 World Baseball Classic are Miami (USA), Houston (USA), Tokyo (Japan), and San Juan (Puerto Rico).
The 2026 World Baseball Classic features four pools.
The 2026 World Baseball Classic has quarterfinals in Houston and Miami.
The 2026 World Baseball Classic has semifinals and the final in Miami.
The next World Baseball Classic tournament is scheduled for 2030.
